name: Camp toilet
description: A folding plastic toilet on four legs, with a seat ring, a lid and a bucket that takes a plastic bag.
notes: Standing open: 33 cm square, seat at 30 cm, lid standing open at the back (-z) and a bucket hung under the seat. CHECK LENGTH (x1.76) is the open lid, which doubles the height; with it shut the iso read as a stool. Folding it swaps to toilet_travel_folded. Using it as a latrine needs a sanitation field the content pass adds.

name: Camp toilet (folded)
description: A plastic camp toilet folded flat, lid shut and legs tucked under, with a carry handle.
notes: A distinct state of toilet_travel with its own model: 28 cm square and 4 cm thick, legs folded under the frame and the carry handle at +z. Unfolding it swaps to toilet_travel.

name: Umbrella
description: A furled black umbrella with a wooden crook handle and a pointed steel tip. It keeps the rain off.
notes: 1.01 m furled, crook at -x and ferrule at +x, strap round the canopy. CHECK VOLUME (x6.1) is the box round a thin rod and the crook. The extended telescoping umbrella is the same furled shape and length, so it rides on this model. Rain cover and a weak poke as a melee block are for the content pass.

name: Spiral stone
description: A flat grey stone carved with a spiral and pierced round its rim. It weighs almost nothing, and the air stirs around it.
notes: 9 cm across and 3.5 cm thick, the spiral painted flush in a dark finish and twelve rim holes painted flush, since compound pieces cannot cut. Mass is the reference's 1 g on purpose: its lightness is the point. Economy is left empty because it is an anomaly drop rather than household loot; its source and any effect are for the content pass.

name: Whistle multitool
description: A cheap orange whistle with a compass on top, a strip thermometer on its side and a small magnifying lens at the end.
notes: 6 cm long with the mouthpiece at -x, compass on top, thermometer on +z, lens at +x and a lanyard loop. magnifying reuses the quality the magnifier draft declares; the lens is too small for fire_starting; a whistle sound and compass bearing need fields the content pass adds.

name: Banjo
description: A five-string banjo with a walnut resonator, a steel hoop round a white drum head and a dark fingerboard.
notes: Lying face up with the neck on +x, drawn at full size and scaled by 0.75 to 82 cm, the nearest a recognisable banjo comes to the reference's 72 cm. Strings are left out: at a 4 mm grain they merge into one strip. CHECK VOLUME (x4.1) is the box round a round pot and a long thin neck. Playing it for morale is for the content pass.

name: Tom drum
description: A red lacquered drum with steel hoops, eight tension lugs and a white head on top.
notes: 28 cm across and 20 cm deep, standing on its bottom head. CHECK VOLUME (x0.28): the reference's 56.6 L is far more than a 28 cm drum fills; the model follows the 28 cm longest side. Playing it and the noise it makes are for the content pass.

name: Hide drum
description: A carved wooden drum with a rawhide head tacked round the rim and laced down to a cord ring.
notes: 28 cm across and 25 cm tall, narrowing to a foot. Economy is empty because it is a hand-made item, crafted rather than found. The reference's 56.6 L volume is far more than the drum fills (box/volume x0.36), as for drum_percussion.
